ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid fraud: A deeper look
ideas.description: Investigate the Minnesota Medicaid fraud cases, including the St. Paul business owner charged with $4M in fraud.
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger organized crime scheme and lead to further convictions.

ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future case: What went wrong
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future case, including the $250M in COVID-19 child meals fraud and the founder's sentencing.
ideas.insight: This story could provide insight into how to prevent similar cases of fraud in the future.
